ideas.title: FBI's Refusal to Share Evidence: A Threat to Transparency and Accountability
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI's decision to withhold evidence from Minnesota investigators in the Alex Pretti shooting case and its implications for transparency and accountability.
questions: What are the reasons behind the FBI's decision to withhold evidence?
How does this decision impact the investigation and the pursuit of justice?
ideas.insight: The FBI's decision to withhold evidence from Minnesota investigators is a concerning trend that requires further investigation. It is essential to examine the reasons behind this decision and ensure that it does not compromise the integrity of the investigation.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of Tax Refund Fraud Schemes
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged $350 million tax refund fraud scheme in Minnesota and the use of shell companies to claim refunds.
questions: What is the extent of the tax refund fraud scheme?
How can authorities prevent and investigate these schemes?
ideas.insight: The use of shell companies in the alleged tax refund fraud scheme is a common tactic used by scammers. It is essential to investigate the entities involved and track the flow of money to uncover the extent of the scheme.
